amendment: The MAE condition is one-sided: median relative MAE change against R3 <= +5 %. Version 1 applied |change| <= 5 %, which rejected an arm that improves both MAE and the range tail. Amended before any real prediction existed (the frozen split had not been created).
question: At a strictly matched budget, does a range-aware objective (R5, R6) lower the tail of the range error to the distal target edge relative to the SPR-space Bayes act (R3), and does it do more than a per-tissue SPR bias correction of R3 (R4)?
aggregation: per-case metrics averaged over seeds before testing; one-sided paired Wilcoxon over development cases; Holm over the four comparisons

verdicts.GAIN: some method arm beats R3 and R4 with MAE within tolerance
verdicts.BIAS CORRECTION SUFFICES: some method arm beats R3 with MAE within tolerance, none beats R4

note: Range proxy only. The gamma-proton part of go/no-go 2 requires the S6 dosimetry subset.
mae_rule: median over cases of MAE_arm / MAE_R3 - 1 must be <= mae_relative_tolerance
